partners.name: 8-bit Productions
partners.tagline: Sound you can feel, clarity you can hear — wherever you are on the dancefloor.
blurb: Our Main Stage sound for 2026 is supplied and engineered by 8-bit Productions, running on a d&b audiotechnik system built to stay clean and controlled from the front of the crowd to the edges of the floor.

Twelve subs in a straight line, tuned to behave like a curve, keep the bass deep and even across the ground. Every speaker gets its own channel, and the whole system is tuned again at sound check and refined through the night as temperature and humidity shift — not louder, just cleaner, deeper, and consistent wherever you're standing.
partners.stage_credit: Sound on this stage is supplied and engineered by 8-bit Productions, running on a d&b audiotechnik system.

partners.name: Barloworld Power
partners.tagline: Keeping the lights on, gate to gate.
blurb: Earthdance Cape Town is officially powered by Barloworld Power Rental! From early site setup right through the main stage performances, Barloworld's temporary power solutions and on-site support are keeping our festival running smoothly. Powered by their reliable Cat® rental generators and distribution equipment, we're guaranteed continuous lights and sound all weekend.

partners.name: BetaState
partners.tagline: Advertising, ticket tracking and the affiliate rep programme.
blurb: BetaState is a Cape Town agency that builds and runs marketing for events and businesses, so they get professional advertising, content and analytics support without building that capability in-house. The team works as an extension of the brands it partners with.

For Earthdance Cape Town 2026, BetaState ran the Meta advertising campaign, tracked ticket sales through Quicket and managed the affiliate rep programme. Across the season the tracking showed which channels moved tickets: the website, paid social and email.
